sections.title: Part 2 · Reading — Shop rules at Blue Star Clothes
sections.sub: Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi.
sections.passage:
Welcome to Blue Star Clothes! Here are some rules for our customers.

Before you buy: you can try clothes on in our fitting rooms. If something is too small or too big, ask a shop assistant. We can check if we have it in the correct size or in a different colour.

Discounts: every Monday, we offer a discount of 20% for students. Please show your student card.

Returns: please keep the receipt. With the receipt, you can return an item within 30 days and get a refund. After 30 days, you can only exchange an item. Without the receipt, we cannot give you a refund, but you can exchange the item for a different size or colour.

Damaged products: if your item is damaged — for example, the zip is broken — bring it back with the receipt. You can get a full refund, or a new one instead.

items.prompt: What can you do in the fitting rooms?
When is the student discount?
The student discount is ____ per cent.
With the receipt, you can get a refund within 30 days.
After 30 days, you can…
Without the receipt, you can get a refund.
Your jacket is damaged and you have the receipt. You can get…
options: a full refund or a new one
answers: a full refund or a new one
items.show: a full refund or a new one

sections.title: Part 3 · Listening — Returning a jacket
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: What does the customer want to return?
The jacket is damaged.
What is the problem?
Does she have the receipt?
She bought it last ____.
The shop has a small jacket in…
What does she get in the end?
The refund is ____ pounds.

script: Yes, please. I'd like to return this jacket.
OK. What's the problem? Is it damaged?
No, it isn't damaged. At first I liked it, but it's too big. It doesn't fit.
I see. Do you have the receipt?
Yes, here's the receipt. I bought it last Saturday.
Thank you. Would you like a refund, or would you like to exchange it for a smaller size?
Do you have it in a small?
Let me check. Sorry, we only have it in large. But we have a small in black.
Hmm, black doesn't suit me. I'd like a refund instead, please.
No problem. That was forty-five pounds, with the discount. Here you are.
